product.olivetti-netstrada-7400.summary: The lower-priced of the two high-end Xeon servers Olivetti refreshed in 1999.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7400.history: In February 1999 Olivetti Computers Worldwide refreshed the NetStrada 7400. Computerwoche reported a German price of about DM 19,000.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7400.architec: The update retained support for up to four processors. The contemporary press reported a move from 400 to 450 MHz Xeons.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7400.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7400.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7400.computer: Computerwoche, Olivetti verpaßt PC-Servern schnellere CPUs, 26 February 1999
